content.short: Lagrange provides secure cross-chain state proofs without bridges.
content.description: Lagrange focuses on improving the security and expressivity of contract state usage. It has developed ZK Big Data, a proving system that simultaneously proves storage inclusion and arbitrary distributed computation on on-chain data. Its ZK solutions enable blockchains to interact directly, allowing dApps to access real-time data such as pricing and liquidity from multiple Layer 1 and Layer 2 networks. This approach supports more interactive, data-rich on-chain applications by enabling access to real-time data across networks.

resources.title: A New Era for ZK: Decentralizing the ZK Stack
resources.tldr: Proof generation concentrated in a few hands recreates the trust problem proofs were meant to remove. The clearest case for prover decentralisation.

resources.title: AI Is Scaling Faster Than We Can Verify It
resources.tldr: Model capability is outrunning any ability to check what a model did. Frames verifiable computation as the missing half rather than an optional extra.

resources.title: Cheap and Fast Cross-Chain Queries With a ZK Coprocessor
resources.tldr: Reading another chain's historical state normally means trusting whoever tells you about it. A concrete look at proving the answer instead of trusting it.
